en.why: The title is already rising on the first frame. Each word group gets its own panel, so every crease falls between words and every face shows a whole word, which keeps the title readable while it folds. The fold stays near 37° and the camera pitch is moderate, so no panel turns edge-on, and the multiplied rows sit 340px apart so no row crosses another. The wide bands carry arrow copy that names the feature (TILT → SKEW → ROTATE → PERSPECTIVE) and double as the transition: the editor appears on the frame where the last band covers the screen, with no extra transition element. In the editor one drag turns the frame and a second drag changes the perspective distance, then the editor dims and the wordmark holds at a large size to the end. The whole film uses black, white and one violet accent.
spec: Timing

Film 10.5s. Title rises line by line through a mask 0–0.8s (expo.out, second line 0.12s later), accent color sweeps across both lines panel by panel 0.3–1.16s; fold 1.0–2.3s (1.3s, 39 frames), second line 0.1s later; row spacing opens from 176px to 340px (1.0–2.4s); 6 more rows multiply 2.25–3.38s (0.95s each, staggered 0.09s per ring); violet sweep over the rows 2.79–3.87s; the four wide bands enter at 3.0s, 3.3s, 3.55s and 3.75s and run to 5.05s; wipe 4.3–5.8s, full cover at 5.05s; editor from 5.05s, Rotate Y handle drag 6.25–7.3s, Distance slider drag 7.8–8.3s, editor dims 8.2–8.85s and the wordmark lands 8.35–9.35s, wordmark holds to 10.5s
Easing

Title rise expo.out; title fold easeInOut cubic; multiplying rows and editor settle expo.out; Rotate Y drag expo.out; band paths monotone cubic splines, fast then slow; wipe easeInOut cubic; Distance slider sine inOut; wordmark fades with easeOut cubic and rises with expo.out
Camera

Rows scene, perspective 2400px: camera pitches down 0°→26° (2.3s)→30° (3.3s)→34° (4.6s)→36° (5.05s), rolls −6°→−10°→−22° (4.6s)→−27° (5.05s), yaw within 4°; it pulls back 300px at 2.3s and 560px at 3.3s to fit more rows, then dollies in to +400px at 4.6s and about +617px at 5.05s. Bands scene, perspective 1100px: dolly 0→360px (3.0–5.1s), roll 0°→−8°. The editor settles from 1.14x scale, 7° tilt and −5° yaw to 1.0 in 1.15s (expo.out), pushes slowly from 6.0s with sine inOut to reach 1.05x at 8.35s, then pulls back to 0.97x as it dims and drifts back to 0.99x by 10.5s
Subject

Each row is a folded strip with one panel per word group, so creases fall only between words: PERSPECTIVE (865px) and FRAMES (545px) in line one, NOW (348px), IN (161px) and PLANAR (537px) in line two; each panel is its word width plus 18px each side (Inter 700, 128px, letter-spacing −0.035em). Neighbouring panels alternate ±37° with their edges joined; the two title rows overshoot to about 44° while folding (peak near 2.3–2.5s, second line 0.1s later) and settle back to 37° by 3.4s (second line 3.5s) so the zig-zag shows sooner; from 2.25s every row breathes ±3°, 34–44° in all; panels leaning away drop to 50% brightness. 8 rows in all, 4 of PERSPECTIVE FRAMES and 4 of NOW IN PLANAR, 340px apart. Bands are 300px, 230px, 420px and 160px high and 9000px wide with text scrolling along them (1100–1700px/s); the wipe band is 3000px thick and carries two lines of 620px type that cross the frame near 4.95s and 5.05s, so the cover frame still shows type, with a 150px white band and a 120px dark band beside it. The editor window is 1700x900 with three phone frames on the canvas
Sync

The last band fills the frame at 5.05s, the rows and bands scenes end on that frame and the editor shows underneath; during the Rotate Y drag the value, the Home frame on the canvas, the highlight box on the Y field and the tooltip above the frame (it follows the cursor sideways) change on the same frame, and the cursor stays on the handle; during the Distance drag the Distance field lights up and the frame's perspective distance changes from 1200px to 450px in step
Style

Background #050507, white type, violet accent #6e56ff (band gradient #5b44f0 → #7a65ff, light violet type #a597ff); three band looks: white type on violet, black type on near-white, violet type on black; the editor is a dark UI with three light phone frames; at the end the editor drops to 20% opacity, a dark radial scrim fades in behind the mark (8.0–8.5s) and the Planar wordmark sits centered (120px icon, Inter 700 at 136px, fading in from 8.35s and growing 2.5% to 10.5s)

缓动
标题升起 expo.out；标题折叠 easeInOut 三次方；增殖出的行和编辑器落位 expo.out；Rotate Y 拖动 expo.out；色带位置用单调三次样条，先快后慢；擦除 easeInOut 三次方；Distance 滑块 sine inOut；字标淡入 easeOut 三次方，上移 expo.out
镜头

行场景透视 2400px：机位下俯 0°→26°（2.3s）→30°（3.3s）→34°（4.6s）→36°（5.05s），横滚 −6°→−10°→−22°（4.6s）→−27°（5.05s），偏航在 4° 以内；机位在 2.3s 拉远 300px、3.3s 拉远 560px 以容纳更多行，4.6s 推近到 +400px，5.05s 推近到约 +617px。色带场景透视 1100px：推近 0→360px（3.0–5.1s），横滚 0°→−8°。编辑器从 1.14 倍缩放、7° 俯仰和 −5° 偏航用 1.15s（expo.out）落到 1.0，再从 6.0s 起用 sine inOut 慢推，到 8.35s 达到 1.05 倍，随后随变暗退到 0.97 倍，再缓缓漂回 0.99 倍直到 10.5s
主体

每行是一条折带，每个词一块面板，折痕只落在词与词之间：第一行 PERSPECTIVE（865px）和 FRAMES（545px）2 段，第二行 NOW（348px）、IN（161px）、PLANAR（537px）3 段，面板宽度是词宽加两侧各 18px（Inter 700，128px，字距 −0.035em）。相邻段交替旋转 ±37°，折线首尾相接；两行标题在折叠时过冲到 44° 左右（2.3–2.5s 到顶，第二行晚 0.1s），3.4s 前后回到 37°（第二行 3.5s），让折痕更早显出锯齿；2.25s 起各行有 ±3° 起伏，整体范围 34–44°；背光的段亮度降到 50%。全片 8 行：PERSPECTIVE FRAMES 4 行，NOW IN PLANAR 4 行，行距 340px。色带高 300、230、420、160px，宽 9000px，文字沿带身滚动（1100–1700px/s）；擦除带厚 3000px，带上有两行 620px 巨型文字（分别在 4.95s 和 5.05s 前后从画面中穿过，铺满画面那一帧仍有字），旁边各跟一条 150px 白带和 120px 深色带。编辑器窗口 1700×900，画布上三个手机画框
同步
最后一条色带在 5.05s 铺满画面，行场景和色带场景在这一帧结束，编辑器从下面露出；拖 Rotate Y 手柄时，数值、画布上的 Home 画框、Y 输入框的高亮框和选中画框上方跟随光标左右移动的提示条在同一帧变化，光标始终压在拖动的把手上；拖 Distance 滑块时，Distance 输入框亮起，画框的透视距离同步从 1200px 变到 450px
风格

背景 #050507，白字，强调色紫 #6e56ff（色带渐变 #5b44f0 → #7a65ff，亮紫字 #a597ff）；色带三种：紫底白字、近白底黑字、黑底紫字；编辑器为深色界面加三个浅色手机画框；结尾编辑器降到 20% 不透明度，字标后面有一层深色径向底（8.0–8.5s 淡入），Planar 字标居中（图标 120px，Inter 700，136px，8.35s 起淡入，到 10.5s 缓慢放大 2.5%）

en.title: 3D Ribbon Text Animation: Example and Code Recipe
en.description: A title folds into zig-zag 3D ribbons, multiplies, then arrow bands sweep past and wipe to the product UI. Make it with Claude Code or Codex.
en.lede: A two-line title folds between its words into zig-zag 3D ribbons and multiplies into a field of rows, wide arrow bands sweep past the camera, the last band fills the frame and wipes to the product UI, and the film ends on the product wordmark.
en.name: 3D Ribbon Text Animation

body.h2: How to make a 3D Ribbon Text Animation with Claude Code or Codex
body.body:
Cut each title line at the word breaks, one panel per word (PERSPECTIVE 865px and FRAMES 545px in line one; NOW 348px, IN 161px and PLANAR 537px in line two), set in Inter 700 at 128px. From 1.0 to 2.3s rotate neighbouring panels alternately by 37° with easeInOut (the two title rows overshoot to about 44° near 2.3–2.5s, then settle back to 37°) so their edges stay joined and the strip folds into a zig-zag whose creases fall between words, while the camera pitches down to 26° with a 2400px perspective. Then open the row spacing from 176px to 340px and add 6 more rows from 2.25 to 3.38s.

From 3.0 to 5.05s send four bands (300, 230, 420 and 160px high) past a camera that dollies in 360px with 1100px perspective, with TILT → SKEW → ROTATE → PERSPECTIVE → and three other short arrow lines scrolling along them at 1100–1700px/s. A 3000px violet band with two lines of 620px type wipes across from 4.3 to 5.8s and covers the frame at 5.05s, where the scene switches to the product UI.

Press the copy button to send this recipe to Claude Code or Codex, or install the skill once with npx skills add krisyangdev/motionboard. The agent builds the folded strips, the band scene and the wipe with GSAP. Render an MP4 with HyperFrames, or port the timeline to your website.

en.alt: Purple and white ribbons of text reading Rotate, Perspective, Skew and Tilt cross a dark screen at steep angles.
faq: How do you make text fold into 3D ribbons?

Split one line at its word breaks into panels that each show one word, then rotate neighbouring panels in opposite directions by about 37° and move each panel so its edge meets the previous one. Animating the angle from 0° over 1.3s folds the strip into a zig-zag, and because the creases fall between words every word stays readable.
How do the bands work as a transition?

The bands carry copy that names the feature and move through a second 3D scene. A thick band sweeps across at 4.3–5.8s and covers the screen at 5.05s, so the next scene can replace the ribbons on that frame.

body.h2: 用 Claude Code 或 Codex 做3D 折带文字动画
body.body:
把每行标题按词切成面板，每个词一块（第一行 PERSPECTIVE 865px、FRAMES 545px，第二行 NOW 348px、IN 161px、PLANAR 537px），用 Inter 700、128px 显示。1.0–2.3s 用 easeInOut 让相邻面板交替旋转 37°（两行标题在 2.3–2.5s 过冲到约 44° 再回到 37°），边与边保持相接，整条折成锯齿状，折痕落在词与词之间，同时机位下俯到 26°，透视 2400px。之后把行距从 176px 拉到 340px，并在 2.25–3.38s 再复制出 6 行。

3.0–5.05s 让四条色带（高 300、230、420、160px）从镜头旁飞过，镜头推近 360px，透视 1100px，「TILT → SKEW → ROTATE → PERSPECTIVE →」和另外三行短箭头文案沿带身以 1100–1700px/s 滚动。4.3–5.8s 一条 3000px 厚、带两行 620px 巨型文字的紫色大带扫过，5.05s 铺满画面，这一帧把场景换成产品界面。

点击复制按钮，把配方发给 Claude Code 或 Codex，也可以用 npx skills add krisyangdev/motionboard 安装 skill。agent 会用 GSAP 做出折带、色带场景和擦除转场。可以用 HyperFrames 渲染成 MP4，也可以把时间线移植到网站上。

zh.alt: 紫色和白色的文字飘带写着 Rotate、Perspective、Skew、Tilt，斜着穿过深色画面。
faq: 文字怎么折成 3D 折带？
把一行字按词切成面板，每个面板只显示一个词，让相邻面板往相反方向各转约 37°，再移动每个面板，使它的边接上前一个的边。让角度在 1.3s 内从 0° 变化到目标值，整条字就折成锯齿状，折痕落在词与词之间，每个词都读得清。
色带上写着点明功能的文案，在第二个 3D 场景里穿过。4.3–5.8s 一条厚色带扫过，5.05s 铺满画面，下一个场景就在这一帧替换掉折带。
可以。Motionboard 免费，使用 MIT 许可证，你可以在个人和商业项目里使用、修改配方和它生成的视频。许可证只要求复制配方文件时保留版权声明。
